content.text:
**Finding: deviation (§ 2.1, p0012)** — validated redline submitted.

- **Issue:** § 2.1 binds us to USD 2,000,000 of Services per year for three years on a take-or-pay basis "without reduction or termination rights" — the rule's walk-away scenario. No exit exists elsewhere: § 8.1 locks a three-year term and § 9 offers only cause-based termination.
- **Internal conflict:** § 12.3 has Vendor acknowledging that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment.
- **Fix:** replaced § 2.1 with a no-minimum-commitment provision (pay only for Services ordered and used), consistent with §§ 7.1 and 12.3, with the 12-month reducible commitment plus true-up offered as a fallback in the comment.
